User interface of the Shiny distribution fitting tool

Source: R/distribution_fitting_tool_UI.R
distribution_fitting_tool_UI.Rd

The page of the distribution fitting application: a welcome tab, the data upload and one tab for each analysis, with the settings beside the results; run_shiny_distribution_fitting_tool pairs it with distribution_fitting_tool_Server. The page is built each time the application starts, not when the package is installed: its theme compiles Bootstrap's SCSS files from where bslib is installed on the machine running it, and a page built at installation kept the paths of the machine that built the package (for a CRAN binary, CRAN's build machine).

Usage

distribution_fitting_tool_UI(request)

Arguments

request

The request of the browser, passed by shiny; not used.

Value

The user interface of the application, a bslib navbar page.
